semiconductor_relevance: High — LK Engineering specializes in electrostatic chucks, which are essential components in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: LK Engineering Co., Ltd. is a global solutions partner focused on providing electrostatic chucks (ESC) for semiconductor manufacturing. The company offers a comprehensive range of ESC solutions, including design, manufacturing, and refurbishment, aimed at enhancing productivity and cost efficiency in fabs.
capabilities: Design and manufacturing of standard and ultra-high-purity ceramic ESCs
Refurbishment of ESCs at 30–50% of the cost of new products

regional_presence.China: The company has established long-term partnerships with leading semiconductor manufacturers in China.
regional_presence.Japan: LK Engineering is recognized for its quality and technical competitiveness in the Japanese market.
regional_presence.USA: The company maintains a presence in the USA, serving key semiconductor manufacturers.
regional_presence.Taiwan: LK Engineering is acknowledged for its competitiveness in the Taiwanese semiconductor sector.
